## Introduction

State the problem and the claim. Cite the evidence that motivates it.

## Related Work

Group the imported literature by theme, not by paper. Each paragraph should
make one comparative point and cite the works that support it.

## Method

Describe what was done, with enough detail to reproduce it.

## Results

Report the measure, the baseline and the effect. Every table and figure needs
a caption that states its takeaway.

## Discussion

Interpret the result, state the limitations honestly, and say what would
change your mind.

## Limitations

List the threats to validity that a careful reader would raise.

## Conclusion

Restate the contribution in one or two sentences.
